description: Read up to 5 web pages in one call and get each as clean Markdown with title and description. Pages are fetched in parallel; a page that fails is reported with its error while the others still return. Charged only if at least one page could be read. Params: urls (array of 1 to 5 http(s) URLs, required), max_chars per page (500 to 30000, default 6000). Price: $0.008 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"urls":["https://agentsvc.io/","https://agentsvc.io/docs"],"max_chars":3000}.
name: web_read_batch
title: Web Read Batch
